    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Analysis
    All measurements for one image, collected in one place.
    App
    Main window of the program.
    Comparison
    Total variation distance (TVD) between two normalized histograms.
    CopyMove
    Looks for copy-move candidates: two 16 x 16 blocks with exactly the same gray values.
    CopyMove.Match
    One candidate pair: the block at (x1, y1) has the same pixels as the block at (x2, y2).
    Edges
    Sobel edge diagnostic.
    FlatPatch
    Finds solid-colour patches (like a Paint fill) in an otherwise noisy image.
    Histogram
    Turns an image into gray values (0 to 255) and a 256-bin histogram.
    HistogramPanel
    Swing panel that draws a normalized 256-bin histogram as bars.
    ImagePanel
    Swing panel that shows an image scaled to fit, keeping its shape (empty bars at the sides).
    LoadedImage
    One image file read from disk: the pixels plus its real format (PNG or JPEG).
    LocalAnomaly
    Local anomaly rule for ONE image.
    Noise
    Noise diagnostic.
    Regions
    Splits the image into square tiles (64 x 64 pixels by default) and measures each tile.
    TamperingAssessment
    Final assessment of ONE image.
    TamperingAssessment.Outcome
    The three possible results of the assessment.
